run_train_text_to_image_decoder: run the Kandinsky 2.2 decoder finetuning script with a dataset and validation prompts
run_parse_args: run the argument parser to validate dataset name or training directory and return parsed args
run_log_validation: run validation by generating images from the finetuned Kandinsky 2.2 decoder pipeline
run_save_model_card: run saving a model card README with training metadata and validation images to a repo folder
run_main: run the full training loop for finetuning the Kandinsky 2.2 decoder UNet with EMA and checkpointing
